intents.text: Add starlette/middleware/body_limit.py with a pure ASGI RequestBodyLimitMiddleware(app, max_body_size: int) that wraps receive, counts the body bytes actually received (including multipart and encoding overhead), and answers with a plain-text 413 Content Too Large once the total exceeds the limit.

Use Content-Length only as a fail-fast check: a declared length over the limit is rejected before the body is read (even if the endpoint never reads it), while an absent or understated header never bypasses the counted-bytes limit; a request exactly at the limit is allowed.

When the limit is crossed after the app has started its response, send no second response; receive still raises starlette.exceptions.HTTPException(413) so standard exception handling produces the 413 or re-raises it if the response already started.

Export the public constant MAX_BODY_SIZE_SCOPE_KEY = "starlette.max_body_size" from the module, store the effective limit in the ASGI scope under it while a limited app runs, and restore the previous value (or its absence) afterwards.
Add a max_body_size: int | None = None keyword to Starlette, Router, Mount and Route, where None keeps unlimited behaviour.

Apply the application-level limit via the middleware stack before routing (so application middleware reading the body is limited), and let an inner route, mount or router limit override the outer one after routing, both raising and lowering it.
In starlette/formparsers.py, close any temporary files created during multipart parsing whenever the parse is interrupted for any reason, including a body-limit error raised mid-stream.

Add tests for the middleware (with/without Content-Length, understated Content-Length, exactly-at-limit, multipart, streaming, no double response), for max_body_size on Starlette, Router, Mount and Route including inner limits raising and lowering the outer one, and for multipart temp-file cleanup; the existing suite must stay green.

constraints: Export nothing new at the package root; import the middleware from starlette.middleware.body_limit
Do not change unrelated behaviour; max_body_size=None must preserve current unlimited behaviour
Existing test suite must remain green
